Class ConquestMapFileReader

java.lang.Object
Services.ConquestMapFileReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ConquestMapFileReader extends Object implements Serializable
A class responsible for reading Conquest map files and creating corresponding map objects.

      public List<String> getMetaData(List<String> p_fileLines, String p_switchParameter)
      Retrieves metadata lines from the given list of file lines based on the specified switch parameter.
      Parameters:
      p_fileLines - The list of lines read from the Conquest map file.
      p_switchParameter - The parameter specifying the type of metadata to retrieve ("continent" or "country").
      Returns:
      A list containing the metadata lines based on the specified switch parameter.

    • readConquestFile

      public void readConquestFile(GameState p_gameState, Map p_map, List<String> p_linesOfFile)
      Reads the Conquest map file and populates the game state and map objects accordingly.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The game state object to be populated with map data.

      p_linesOfFile - The list of lines read from the Conquest map file.
